character.name: 主角小金毛柯基波比 (Bobby the Corgi)
character.prompt: A chubby, adorable 3-month-old golden corgi puppy with fluffy caramel and cream fur, distinctive white chest patch, big round expressive warm amber eyes, soft pink nose, velvety floppy ears, stubby short legs, and an energetic wagging tail. Pixar 3D animated character design with hyper-expressive emotions.
character.negative: adult dog, skinny, long legs, black fur, aggressive, realistic photographic dog, deformed paws, extra limbs

character.name: 温和小女孩艾米 (Amy the Little Girl)
character.prompt: A sweet 7-year-old girl with wavy hazelnut brown hair in twin pigtails tied with orange ribbons, rosy cheeks, bright joyful smile, wearing a cozy oversized mustard-yellow knitted sweater and denim dungarees. Warm, kind, Pixar 3D animated aesthetic.

scene.name: 万圣节温馨木屋门廊 (Cozy Porch)
scene.prompt: A charming rustic wooden cottage front porch at golden dusk, decorated for Halloween with carved glowing jack-o'-lantern pumpkins of various sizes, scattered crispy amber and crimson autumn maple leaves, soft glowing fairy lights strung across the porch eaves, a welcoming dark-green wooden front door with a brass door knocker and a rustic woven welcome mat.

scene.name: 室内暖光壁炉客厅 (Warm Fireplace Room)
